races.name: Human
races.description: Adaptable and ambitious. A short, bright arc.

races.name: Elf
races.description: Long-lived and graceful. Improves for centuries.

races.name: Orc
races.description: Powerful and fierce. Peaks brutally early.

races.name: Dwarf
races.description: Hardy and stubborn. Slow to mature, slow to fade.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: Wielder of nature magic and wild shapes.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: Performer whose music carries real power.

stat_categories.name: Proficiencies
stat_categories.description: Trained competencies - what they can do.

stat_categories.name: Mentals
stat_categories.description: Temperament and knowledge - how they think.

stat_categories.name: Physicals
stat_categories.description: Raw bodily attributes - what the body can do.

stats.name: Unarmed
stats.description: Fists, grapples and improvised blows.

stats.name: One-Handed Weapons
stats.description: Swords, axes, maces and other single-hand arms.

stats.name: Two-Handed Weapons
stats.description: Greatswords, polearms and heavy two-hand arms.

stats.name: Ranged Weapons
stats.description: Bows, crossbows, slings and thrown weapons.

stats.name: Shields
stats.description: Blocking, shield bashes and holding the line.

stats.name: Spell Casting
stats.description: Technical execution of spells - accuracy and control.

stats.name: Alchemy
stats.description: Brewing potions, poisons and identifying reagents.

stats.name: Stealth
stats.description: Moving unseen and unheard.

stats.name: Thieving
stats.description: Pickpocketing and lockpicking.

stats.name: Critical Thinking
stats.description: Solving puzzles, riddles and mechanisms.

stats.name: Bravery
stats.description: Willingness to attempt the riskier act.

stats.name: Decisions
stats.description: Judging whether the risky act will actually work.

stats.name: Willpower
stats.description: Resisting fear, magic, temptation and pain.

stats.name: Leadership
stats.description: Effectiveness when instructing the party.

stats.name: Teamwork
stats.description: Willingness to follow instructions and support.

stats.name: Vision
stats.description: Spotting hidden events, traps and enemies.

stats.name: Arcana
stats.description: Knowledge of magic, magical places, people, enemies.

stats.name: Warfare
stats.description: Reading a fight, tactics and exploiting openings.

stats.name: Nature
stats.description: Wild enemies, beasts and non-magical healing.

stats.name: Guile
stats.description: Persuasion, deception and reading people.

stats.name: Strength
stats.description: Force, lifting and melee damage.

stats.name: Finesse
stats.description: Precision and sleight of hand.

stats.name: Speed
stats.description: Reactions, initiative and dodging.

stats.name: Endurance
stats.description: Stamina, resisting poison, cold and exhaustion.

stats.name: Acrobatics
stats.description: Balance and contortion.

stats.name: Athletics
stats.description: Running, jumping and climbing.

locations.name: Riverhold
locations.description: A busy crossroads town. Everyone passes through eventually.

locations.name: Silverbough Vale
locations.description: Ancient woodland halls. Outsiders are tolerated, not welcomed.

locations.name: Underbrook Hollow
locations.description: Burrow-homes and long lunches. Little trouble, and few warriors.

locations.name: Karak Dunmar
locations.description: Deep forges under stone. Grim, wealthy and heavily armed.

locations.name: Grukmar Warcamp
locations.description: A sprawl of tents and pit-fights. Blades are cheap here.

locations.name: Tinkerspire
locations.description: Clockwork spires and alchemical smog. Ideas outnumber people.

locations.name: Saltmere Port
locations.description: Every race, every trade, every kind of trouble. Nobody is a local.

locations.name: Aurum Vale
locations.description: A banking republic of a hundred flags. Talent goes to the highest bid.

locations.name: The Thousand Gates
locations.description: A caravan hub the size of a kingdom. The world empties through it.

reputation_tiers.name: Hapless
reputation_tiers.description: Barely competent. Cheap, and you get what you pay for.

reputation_tiers.name: Capable
reputation_tiers.description: A solid pair of hands. The bulk of any tavern.

reputation_tiers.name: Elite
reputation_tiers.description: Regionally famous. Rare on the open market.

age_development_curve.name: Prodigy
age_development_curve.description: Raw and unproven. Enormous room to grow.

age_development_curve.name: Developing
age_development_curve.description: Coming along nicely. Still cheap to hire.

age_development_curve.name: Rising
age_development_curve.description: Nearly the finished article. Price is climbing.

age_development_curve.name: Peak
age_development_curve.description: At the height of their powers.

age_development_curve.name: Established
age_development_curve.description: Fully realised. What you see is what you get.

age_development_curve.name: Fading
age_development_curve.description: Still formidable, but the body is slowing.

age_development_curve.name: Declining
age_development_curve.description: Experience is all that remains, and it is not enough.

age_development_curve.name: Twilight
age_development_curve.description: A name and a story. Hire for the tale, not the fight.

wage_satisfaction_bands.name: Furious
wage_satisfaction_bands.description: Insulted by their pay. Actively looking to leave.

wage_satisfaction_bands.name: Unhappy
wage_satisfaction_bands.description: Feels badly underpaid and says so.

wage_satisfaction_bands.name: Unsettled
wage_satisfaction_bands.description: Grumbling. Would listen to a better offer.

wage_satisfaction_bands.name: Content
wage_satisfaction_bands.description: Paid the going rate. No complaints.

wage_satisfaction_bands.name: Happy
wage_satisfaction_bands.description: Paid above their worth and knows it.

wage_satisfaction_bands.name: Delighted
wage_satisfaction_bands.description: Being paid a small fortune. Going nowhere.
